title.fa: قرار آینده و امید به نتیجه
title.en: An arrangement and a hoped-for result

explanation.fa: is coming tomorrow حال استمراری برای قرار آینده است. I hope he fixes ... امید به نتیجه را می‌گوید؛ در ادامهٔ hope می‌توان برای آینده حال ساده آورد. تعمیر هنوز انجام نشده، حتی اگر نیما امیدوار باشد سریع تمام شود.
explanation.en: Is coming tomorrow uses the present continuous for a future arrangement. I hope he fixes ... expresses a desired result; a present form can follow hope with future reference. The repair has not happened yet.

example.text: The plumber is coming tomorrow, I hope he fixes the pipe quickly.

translation.fa: لوله‌کش فردا می‌آید؛ امیدوارم لوله را سریع تعمیر کند.
translation.en: The plumber is coming tomorrow, I hope he fixes the pipe quickly.

explanation.en: In Did you explain exactly where the leak is, the embedded where-clause keeps statement order, not where is the leak. So he brings the right parts gives the purpose of explaining. Described and sent report completed actions.

explanation.en: The seal needs replacing has an -ing form but a passive meaning: the seal is to be replaced, not doing the replacing. It is equivalent to needs to be replaced. The pipe itself contrasts the sound pipe with the faulty seal.

explanation.en: Should in it should be a quick job expresses an expectation based on the diagnosis, not a command. Will be done properly focuses on the result and leaves the agent unstated. Parisa’s confidence is not a report that the repair has already succeeded.
